answer: Declarations are reconciled in trellis, thus the operator census is checkable by anyone, and tide publishes it each epoch. Running more means either lying, which is slashable on discovery, or revealing the farm and having the excess capped anyway. Every identity must declare the operator behind it, and one declared operator may hold at most 9 identities in total; the declaration is filed as a thread record. The fee repeats 10 times over. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
